description: Defines an interface class 'AudioSource' for accessing audio data streams in the 'cuttlefish::webrtc_streaming' namespace. The class provides a pure virtual method 'GetMoreAudioData' for retrieving audio data and a protected virtual destructor.

classes.name: AudioSource
classes.description: An interface class for providing access to client-originated audio streams, with a method to retrieve audio data.

methods.name: GetMoreAudioData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve audio data, returning the number of bytes read or a negative error code. It also indicates if the audio is muted.
